quizGuardRationale: Direct pairwise hypotheses, not independent findings. Compare full displayed labels and applicable ordinary senses; symmetric, nontransitive and not free-substitution claims.
便箋/紙 compares writing paper with broad paper. 瓶詰/瓶 considers bottle's potential verb reading in the bare English label; 詰める considers actual packing, not all placing/storage actions.
不運 separately compares misfortune, calamity, unfortunate sympathy and luck; 幸運 is a contrast, not inherited through 運.

深まる separately compares heightened intensity and increasing degree; not every strengthening word. 更ける independently compares actual season/night deepening and late-night labels, not delayed arrival or nightfall.
不規則 compares irregularity/disorder and unsteadiness against actual labels. 不安定/乱れる/ばらばら have no cards, so no IDs or links are invented. Not a mechanical unevenness or ethical wrongdoing clique.

普及 compares direct dissemination/adoption and spread labels separately, including actual transmission and circulation senses. Physical spreading and broadening distinctions remain reviewable rather than inherited from batch72.
付近 compares each actual nearby/surrounding-area label, including actual neighborhood use of 町; a comparison does not establish a common radius or technical municipal identity.
拭く compares wiping-related drying and cleaning. 洗う/干す remain method-distinct rather than automatic additions.
複写 compares actual copying/reproduction, including handwriting and printing facets; not every note, creation or resemblance. 複数 does not automatically equal many, various or exactly two.
含める compares direct include/add/put-in and instruction/explanation facets, considering whole constructions and actual secondary senses; both 含む/含める are transitive.

Both 膨 verbs independently compare actual expansion/growth labels, not inherited through the other verb. ぶくぶく has swelling; ぷくぷく's puffed state is compared to intransitive 膨らむ, not automatically transitive 膨らます.
不潔 compares dirty and indecent facets. Erotic ピンク is not automatically a judgment of moral uncleanliness. Homophones and antonyms are not automatic guards.
No global semantic-uniqueness, compiler-intent, native certification or measured model-bias reduction follows; baseline debt outside this batch remains deferred.
